opening.argument: The presentation leads with a promise of up to $10,000 for free, then directs viewers to send liquidity from a wallet to a new contract. Its description says, “The flash loan will be paid back automatically and any profit will be returned to your wallet in a few seconds/minutes,” while the narration walks through a 1000-BNB loan and activating the launched contract. That combination presents a rapid, cost-free return tied to depositing assets and deploying a contract. An educational disclaimer may qualify the presentation, and the available evidence does not verify the contract’s behavior or profitability, nor establish that any viewer lost money. Even so, the stated payout and operational instructions are the central observable features.
